description: Upload a file to Google Drive from a file:// or http(s):// URI. Content is streamed from the source (no temp files) in a single multipart request. Returns file ID for use in other operations.

description.description: Description to store in the file metadata

mimeType.description: MIME type, e.g. application/pdf (defaults to the Content-Type header or detection from the file extension)

name.description: File name in Drive, including extension (defaults to the source file name)

parentId.description: Parent folder ID (omit to upload to My Drive root)

sourceUri.description: File URI to upload (file://, http://, https://)

name: file-upload

itemsProcessed.description: Total items attempted (always 1 for single file)

mimeType.description: MIME type of the uploaded file

operationSummary.description: Summary of the file upload operation

size.description: Size of the uploaded file in bytes

webViewLink.description: URL to view the file in Drive

title: Upload File
